source.note: Final LabCord Foundation variables plus two explicit legacy public roles. The previous .fig identity is retained for component-layout provenance. Runtime does not parse this file.

currentFoundation.note: Read-only Figma Plugin API export. Canonical Foundation values come from this file. Existing component-specific bindings retain their separately verified source.

source.selection: Component-bound rows are selected by the explicit roleVariableIDs map. A same-name local Semantic row is never selected by position.
source.note: The external Semantic collection is the authoritative source for roles actually bound on the target page. Local Semantic values remain preserved below for unbound roles and provenance comparison. Component-specific bindings are preserved separately and never inserted into the Semantic role map.

pageBindingEvidence.note: Page-wide bindings include local Semantic context as well as product roles. Product role values use the explicit external roleVariableIDs map; local same-name rows remain provenance only.

source.finalFoundationCompatibility: The existing component-bound role values are unchanged in the final Foundation. These rows retain original consumer provenance; newly added and previously unbound canonical roles resolve through the final variables array.
